component.name: FloatBoard
component.summary: Always-on-top floating clipboard manager, sticky notes, and image reference board

description.p: FloatBoard is a desktop productivity utility that lets you pin clipboard history, sticky notes, code snippets, and image references directly on top of any window without losing focus.

ul.li: Always-on-top floating canvas that stays above all windows and full-screen apps
Automatic live clipboard history capture for text, code snippets, and screenshots
Compact translucent notes and todo checklists
Visual reference board for side-by-side design and development comparison
100% offline local storage privacy with zero telemetry or cloud requirements

description.p: Release v1.0.20: Updated packaging, performance improvements, and full Wayland and X11 support.
